verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer-token auth that can access, create and manipulate content, plus an official MCP server for custom agents and bots. Together these let scripts and agents automate a space without the GUI, and scheduled automated exports produce machine-readable output. However, nothing documents a headless runtime, CLI, or CI integration, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 at every candidate path, so automation has to be hand-built against the API. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless mode, documented CI/pipeline usage, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
